name: serpapi_home_depot
description: Search The Home Depot products through SerpApi with normalized product fields like product_id, brand, model_number, price, rating, reviews, thumbnail, image_url, delivery, pickup, and stock information. Use this for Home Depot product searches, focused product details by product_id, store/ZIP-specific availability, price-sorted comparisons, and follow-up product references. For US searches, delivery_zip defaults to JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE when omitted. In detailed/display mode, show product images from image_url/top_image_url when present. Keep normal searches cached and lightweight; only use no_cache or include_product_details when the user explicitly needs fresh availability or full product-page details.

query.description: Home Depot search query, such as cordless drill, hammer, patio chair, or plywood. Required unless product_id is provided.

product_id.description: Optional Home Depot US product ID for a focused home_depot_product lookup with richer details and product images. If query is also provided, this can select which result to enrich.

country.description: Home Depot country: us or ca. Default: us.

sort_by.description: Friendly sort mode. US values map to top_sellers, price_low_to_high, price_high_to_low, top_rated, best_match. Canada values map to price-asc, price-desc, reviewAvgRating, relevance.

hd_filter_tokens.description: US filter token string or list. Tokens can be obtained from a prior response's filters.

filter.description: Canada filter token string, with tokens separated by dashes.

delivery_zip.description: US ZIP code for shipping/product availability filtering. Defaults to JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE when omitted.

store_id.description: US Home Depot store ID for local product filtering.

store.description: Canada Home Depot store ID. Default on Home Depot Canada is Gatineau (7140).

minmax.description: Canada price range filter, such as price:[100 TO 500], price:[100 TO *], or price:[0 TO 500].

nao.description: US product offset. Home Depot commonly uses 24 results per page.

page.description: Results page number. Common to US and Canada searches.

ps.description: US page size. Home Depot may override it; maximum is usually 48.

pagesize.description: Canada page size. Default and maximum are usually 40.

num_results.description: How many normalized product results to return. Clamped to 1..10. Default: 5.

include_product_details.description: If true, make an additional Home Depot Product API call for the selected/top US product, including larger image_url, description, highlights, bullets, and specifications. This is slower. Default: false for normal search; use true only when the user asks for full product-page details.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for a fresh live Home Depot fetch. This can be much slower and should only be used when the user explicitly asks for current/live availability or fresh pricing.

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi Home Depot parameters passed through, excluding reserved keys.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw.
